# NewsCard

Figma: [07m. NewsCard](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=3284-3606) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

An update / news card for a deal or project - header (chevron + title + subtitle), a content paragraph, a status badge + date, and an underline. Three styles (Plain · Boxed · Media), RTL & LTR. Composes Content, StatusPill and Syntropy icons.

### NewsCard

Update card about a deal or project (status change, milestone, announcement): title and developer, update paragraph, StatusPill and last-updated date, in Plain feed, Boxed and Media (thumbnail) styles.

Level: organism · Contains: Content, NewsCard / Meta, StatusPill

Use when:
- Updates feed or a deal's activity list (Style=Plain, underline separates items)
- A single standalone update (Style=Boxed)
- Richer updates with a photo (Style=Media)

Don't use when:
- The deal itself: use CardDeal or Base card (HeaderCard)
- Swipeable visual updates on the deal page: use NewsCard / Poster Carousel
- System alerts: use Alert or Banner

Accessibility: Link named by the title when tappable (drop the chevron otherwise); status text not colour only; date in Western digits.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

NewsCard surfaces an update about a deal or project - a status change, a milestone, an announcement. It reads top-down: header (what it’s about) → content (the update) → status badge + date → underline. Use it in an updates feed or a deal’s activity list; for the deal itself use HeaderCard / CardDeal.

### Anatomy

Header (optional chevron + title + subtitle via Content) → content paragraph → Meta (status badge + last-updated date) → underline.

Plain

### Styles

Plain (flush, underline divider - for feeds/lists), Boxed (bordered card - standalone), Media (boxed + leading thumbnail - richer updates).

Plain

Boxed

Media

### Direction - RTL & LTR

Mirrors fully - chevron side, text alignment, badge/date order and the thumbnail flip.

RTL

LTR

### Status badge

The badge is a StatusPill - swap its tone + label for the update’s status. Calendar icon shows by default.

warning

success

info

neutral

### Optional content

Chevron and the content paragraph are independent toggles - drop the chevron when the card isn’t tappable, or the body for a headline-only update.

All on

No chevron

No content

### Code examples

Flutter usage of NewsCard.

```dart
SafqahNewsCard(
  style: NewsStyle.media,
  title: update.projectName,
  subtitle: update.developer,
  content: update.body,
  status: StatusBadge(tone: Tone.warning, label: 'Behind schedule'),
  date: 'Updated 21 Jul 2024',
  image: update.thumbnail,
  onTap: () => openUpdate(update.id),
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Use Plain in an updates feed - the underline separates consecutive cards cleanly.

Don’t

Don’t box every row in a dense feed - stacked bordered cards get noisy; use Plain.

Do

Match the badge tone to the status (warning = behind, success = on track) with a clear label.

Don’t

Don’t use NewsCard for the deal itself - use HeaderCard / CardDeal; NewsCard is for updates about it.

### Overview

NewsCard / Poster is the visual sibling of the classic NewsCard: the same job (an update about a deal or project) told through imagery. It is a portrait 280×479 card meant to be swiped through in a carousel on the deal page and the home feed. Reading order: photo → last-updated tab → issuer logo → title → description → status + open action.

### Anatomy

Surface (Color/Alpha/White/80 + border/default, radius/xl, padding space/sm) → Poster Media (photo + frost fade + scrim + progressive blur) → Tag (dealTags · ClosedWhite, top end corner) → Caption (Logo + Title + Description, text/inverse) → Actions (IssuanceStatusBadge at the start, IconButton at the end).

Poster · RTL

### Composition

Three molecules, each its own component: Poster Media (swap the photo on the Image layer), Poster Caption (Logo instance-swap, Title, Description) and Poster Actions (Has status, Has action; nested badge and icon button exposed).

Poster Media

Poster Caption

Poster Actions

### Direction - RTL & LTR

Mirrors fully: the tag moves to the top end corner with its tab radii flipped, text alignment flips, the badge sits at the start and the icon button at the end with arrow-diagonal-up-left (RTL) / up-right (LTR).

RTL

LTR

### Status & action

The status is an IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor) exposed on the instance: pick the Status variant for the colour and edit the label. Project updates use three statuses only: On track (وفق الخطة) → Funded (purple), Late (متأخر) → Late (orange), Construction completed (انتهى البناء) → Confirmed (brand green). The open action is a tertiary IconButton with a radius/full override.

On track · Funded · RTL

Late · Late · RTL

Construction completed · Confirmed · RTL

On track · Funded · LTR

Late · Late · LTR

Construction completed · Confirmed · LTR

### Booleans

Has tag on the poster; Has logo and Has description on the caption; Has status and Has action on the footer. Drop the tag for evergreen content, the action when the card is not tappable.

All on

No tag

No logo · no description

### Code examples

Flutter usage of NewsCard / Poster inside the updates carousel.

```dart
SafqahPosterCard(
  image: update.coverImage,
  logo: update.issuerLogo,
  title: update.projectName,
  description: update.body,
  lastUpdated: update.date,
  status: IssuanceStatus.confirmed,
  statusLabel: "وفق الخطة",
  onOpen: () => context.push(update.route),
)

SafqahPosterCarousel(
  items: updates,
  gap: SafqahSpace.lg,
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Use Poster inside the updates carousel: one full poster plus a peek of the next tells the user there is more to swipe.

Don’t

Don’t stack posters vertically in a feed; at 479px each they bury the rest of the page. Use the classic NewsCard (Plain) for feeds.

Do

Keep the caption short: a one-line title and two to three lines of description. The blur only guarantees contrast in the lower third of the photo.

Don’t

Don’t remove the status and the last-updated tab together; without them the poster reads as a marketing banner, not an update.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Built atoms-first from the Newscard frame (5285:85467): Developer Logo → Poster Media (the effect stack is cloned: progressive layer blur on the image, frosted fade, overlay scrim, progressive background blur) → Caption → Actions → Poster → Poster Carousel. Reuses IconButton, IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor) and dealTags (the new ClosedWhite type: bg/base + text/muted). No other shipped component was modified.:** Token refit (2026-09-14): every effect radius, shadow offset, effect colour and gradient stop is bound. Image blur Shadow/Blur/LG, inner glow Alpha/White/10 + Shadow/Blur/MD, frost blur Shadow/Blur/LG + Alpha/White/80, scrim ramp Alpha/Black/10 → 30 → 50 → 70 → Shade/Black with drop shadow Shadow/Blur/SM + OffsetY/MD + Alpha/Black/30. The progressive background blur is bound to font/line-height/48 (resolves to ≈72px) and its ramp starts at Alpha/Black/30 → 10 → 50 → 70 → Shade/Black. Still raw because no token exists: stroke widths 1 / 1.5, card 280×479, media 264×463, carousel 358, fully transparent stops.

> **Title and Description are shared TEXT properties: Arabic copy is the default and the LTR poster overrides it on its Caption instance. The classic NewsCard set is untouched; if Poster should become a fourth Style there, say so and it can be merged.:** The image stroke inside Poster Media is bound to border/focus, exactly as in the source frame. It sits under the container’s border/subtle and only shows as a soft dark edge inside the blur; consider a media-specific border token.
